annotations.title: List the speakers in a transcript

description:
List the speakers in a meeting transcript and how many words each said, without scoring anything.

        transcript: the complete prepared transcript, never just a file preview, one speaker turn per line
        ("Name: words"). This tool also receives the text: restricted information must be removed before transfer,
        as described in the server instructions. A user-selected excerpt is allowed.
name: check_transcript
title: List the speakers in a transcript
